title: awl Bootstrap Node
description: awl-bootstrap-node: clients, relay service, DHT server, AutoNAT service, connections and resources.

panels.title: Node info
panels.description: Version, peer ID, Go version, OS and arch of each node.

targets.expr: max by (instance, version, peer_id, go_version, os, arch) (awl_bootstrap_node_info{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Relay service
panels.description: 1: the relay service is running.

panels.title: Active reservations
panels.description: Opened minus closed since the start; renewals are not new reservations. Limit: MaxReservations.

panels.title: Active circuits
panels.description: Relayed connections open now: opened minus closed since the start.

panels.title: Bootstrap peers connected
panels.description: Other bootstrap nodes this node is connected to. 0: it is cut off from them.

panels.title: Reachable addresses
panels.description: Addresses of the node that AutoNAT v2 found reachable from outside. 0: peers cannot reach the node. AutoNAT reachability does not tell it here: the node forces public reachability.

panels.title: Clients by version
panels.description: Connected awl peers, stacked: how a new release spreads. Pick one node: every node sees most of the network.

panels.title: Clients by OS
panels.description: Connected awl peers, stacked. Pick one node: every node sees most of the network.

panels.title: DHT requests per client
panels.description: Per minute, for one connected client of each version.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, version) (rate(awl_bootstrap_p2p_dht_requests_total{instance=~"$instance",app="awl"}[$__rate_interval]))*60 / sum by (instance, version) (awl_bootstrap_p2p_peers_connected{instance=~"$instance",app="awl"})

panels.title: Reservations
panels.description: Peers behind NAT holding a reservation, so that others can reach them through this node.

panels.title: Reservation events
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: Reservation rejections
panels.description: Per minute. Limits: per IP, per ASN, total.

panels.title: Circuit rejections
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: Relayed data
panels.description: Each circuit is limited to 2 minutes and 21 MiB.

panels.title: Circuit duration p50 / p95
panels.description: Failed circuits are in the histogram too, under 1 s.

panels.title: Request responses
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: Closed by the limit
panels.description: Of the successful circuits, the share that ran until the relay limit of 2 minutes (110–125 s). 590–610 s are counted too, for a limit of 10 minutes. Over the time range of the dashboard.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(awl_bootstrap_p2p_relay_circuit_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",le=~"125|125.0"}[$__range])) - sum by (instance) (rate(awl_bootstrap_p2p_relay_circuit_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",le=~"110|110.0"}[$__range])) + sum by (instance) (rate(awl_bootstrap_p2p_relay_circuit_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",le=~"610|610.0"}[$__range])) - sum by (instance) (rate(awl_bootstrap_p2p_relay_circuit_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",le=~"590|590.0"}[$__range]))) / sum by (instance) (rate(libp2p_relaysvc_connection_request_response_status_total{instance=~"$instance",status="ok"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Traffic by protocol, in
panels.description: Stacked. unknown: before a stream agrees on a protocol.

panels.title: Traffic by protocol, out
panels.description: Stacked. unknown: before a stream agrees on a protocol.

panels.title: Host network vs libp2p
panels.description: host: IP traffic of the whole host, loopback included, so scraping the metrics counts too. The metric says “by the process”, but it is not. libp2p: data of libp2p streams only.

panels.title: Relayed share of traffic
panels.description: Streams of the relay protocol, of all libp2p traffic. A relayed byte goes in and out.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, transport) (libp2p_swarm_connections_opened_total{instance=~"$instance"}) - sum by (instance, transport) (libp2p_swarm_connections_closed_total{instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: New connections
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: Short connections
panels.description: Per minute: connections closed within 64 s, by transport. Clients that reconnect all the time show up here.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Per minute: requests from clients and from the other bootstrap nodes.

panels.title: Message errors
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: AutoNAT v2 requests served
panels.description: Per minute. Peers asking whether their addresses are reachable.

panels.title: AutoNAT v2 dial-backs
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: AutoNAT v1 responses and refusals
panels.description: Per minute. Rate limit: 2 per second from one peer.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of one core.

panels.title: Streams by protocol
panels.description: The 10 protocols with the most open streams.

panels.title: Blocked by the resource manager
panels.description: Total since the start. Limits are infinite on the bootstrap node, so anything here is unexpected.

panels.title: Allocations
panels.description: Bytes allocated per second.

panels.title: Peerstore
panels.description: The peerstore is kept on disk: steady growth means it is never pruned.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: How long reading /metrics of the node takes. When a scrape fails, the other panels have a gap.
